title: LanPaint: real mask-conditioned inpainting across every supported model
description: Replace the regenerate-the-whole-crop localised edit with InpaintCropImproved -> LanPaint_KSampler -> InpaintStitchImproved. LanPaint (scraed/LanPaint, GPL-3.0) makes the sampler condition on the surrounding known pixels instead of generating the crop blind, which is the root of the mask-shaped tone patch documented in docs/models/krea2/injection.md. PROVEN on the bench 2026-08-22 on Klein 4B distilled - the checkpoint we ship - and on 9B. Ships as a pinned third-party dep plus a MadPonyInteractive fork; LTX 2.5 (release 1.6) is the one model that needs an upstream code contribution.
